question.:question/problem: Evaluate $\displaystyle\int_C F\cdot\mathrm{d}r$ given that $F(x,y,z)=\left(1\right)\,i+\left(-3\right)\,j+\left(-1\right)\,k$ and $C$ is the path $r(t)=\left(t - 1\right)\,i+\left(1 - t\right)\,j+\left(t - 2\right)\,k$ for $t\in [0,2]$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
We will use the formula

$$
\int_C F\cdot\mathrm{d}r=\int_a^b F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm{d}t.
$$

Along the curve $C,$ we have 

$$
x=t - 1,\qquad y=1 - t,\qquad z=t - 2.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\left(1\right)\,i+\left(-3\right)\,j+\left(-1\right)\,k \\ & =\left(1\right)\,i+\left(-3\right)\,j+\left(-1\right)\,k \\ & =\left(1\right)\,i+\left(-3\right)\,j+\left(-1\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r^{\prime}(t),$ we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\,i+\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}\,j+\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}t}\,k \\ & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(t - 1\right)\,i+\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(1 - t\right)\,j+\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(t - 2\right)\,k \\ & =\left(1\right)\,i+\left(-1\right)\,j+\left(1\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(1\right)\,i+\left(-3\right)\,j+\left(-1\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(1\right)\,i+\left(-1\right)\,j+\left(1\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(\left(1\right)\cdot\left(1\right)\right)+\left(\left(-3\right)\cdot\left(-1\right)\right)+\left(\left(-1\right)\cdot\left(1\right)\right) \\ & =\left(1\right)+\left(3\right)+\left(-1\right) \\ & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_C F\cdot\mathrm{d}r & =\int_{0}^{2}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm{d}t \\ & =\int_{0}^{2}\left(3\right)\,\mathrm{d}t \\ & =\left[3 t\right]_{0}^{2} \\ & =\left(3 \left(2\right)\right)+\left(-\left(3 \left(0\right)\right)\right) \\ & =\left(6\right)+\left(0\right) \\ & =6\end{aligned}
$$

$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(3 e^{3 t}\right)\,i+\left(- e^{- 3 t}\right)\,j+\left(3 e^{t}\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(3 e^{- 3 t}\right)\,i+\left(9 e^{3 t}\right)\,j+\left(3 e^{t}\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(\left(3 e^{3 t}\right)\cdot\left(3 e^{- 3 t}\right)\right)+\left(\left(- e^{- 3 t}\right)\cdot\left(9 e^{3 t}\right)\right)+\left(\left(3 e^{t}\right)\cdot\left(3 e^{t}\right)\right) \\ & =\left(9\right)+\left(-9\right)+\left(9 e^{2 t}\right) \\ & =9 e^{2 t}\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_C F\cdot\mathrm{d}r & =\int_{0}^{1}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm{d}t \\ & =\int_{0}^{1}\left(9 e^{2 t}\right)\,\mathrm{d}t \\ & =\left[\frac{9 e^{2 t}}{2}\right]_{0}^{1} \\ & =\left(\frac{9 e^{2 \left(1\right)}}{2}\right)+\left(-\left(\frac{9 e^{2 \left(0\right)}}{2}\right)\right) \\ & =\left(\frac{9 e^{2}}{2}\right)+\left(- \frac{9}{2}\right) \\ & =- \frac{9}{2} + \frac{9 e^{2}}{2}\end{aligned}

$$

$$

Along the curve $C,$ we have 

$$
x=3 \cos{\left(t \right)},\qquad y=3 \sin{\left(t \right)},\qquad z=3 \sqrt{t}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\left(x\right)\,i+\left(y\right)\,j+\left(z\right)\,k \\ & =\left(\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\right)\,i+\left(\left(3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\right)\,j+\left(\left(3 \sqrt{t}\right)\right)\,k \\ & =\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(3 \sqrt{t}\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r^{\prime}(t),$ we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\,i+\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}\,j+\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}t}\,k \\ & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(3 \sqrt{t}\right)\,k \\ & =\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(\frac{3}{2 \sqrt{t}}\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(3 \sqrt{t}\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(\frac{3}{2 \sqrt{t}}\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\right)+\left(\left(3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\right)+\left(\left(3 \sqrt{t}\right)\cdot\left(\frac{3}{2 \sqrt{t}}\right)\right) \\ & =\left(- 9 \sin{\left(t \right)} \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(9 \sin{\left(t \right)} \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(\frac{9}{2}\right) \\ & =\frac{9}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_C F\cdot\mathrm{d}r & =\int_{2}^{2 \pi}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t)\,\mathrm{d}t \\ & =\int_{2}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{9}{2}\right)\,\mathrm{d}t \\ & =\left[\frac{9 t}{2}\right]_{2}^{2 \pi} \\ & =\left(\frac{9 \left(2 \pi\right)}{2}\right)+\left(-\left(\frac{9 \left(2\right)}{2}\right)\right) \\ & =\left(9 \pi\right)+\left(-9\right) \\ & =-9 + 9 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\left(x\right)\,i+\left(z\right)\,j+\left(y\right)\,k \\ & =\left(\left(2 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\right)\,i+\left(\left(- 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\right)\,j+\left(\left(- 3 \sec{\left(t \right)}\right)\right)\,k \\ & =\left(2 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(- 3 \sec{\left(t \right)}\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r^{\prime}(t),$ we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}r^{\prime}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\,i+\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}\,j+\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}t}\,k \\ & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(2 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(- 3 \sec{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(- 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,k \\ & =\left(2 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \tan{\left(t \right)} \sec{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(2 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(- 3 \sec{\left(t \right)}\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(2 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \tan{\left(t \right)} \sec{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(\left(2 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(2 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\right)+\left(\left(- 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(- 3 \tan{\left(t \right)} \sec{\left(t \right)}\right)\right)+\left(\left(- 3 \sec{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\right) \\ & =\left(4 \sin{\left(t \right)} \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(9 \cos{\left(t \right)} \tan{\left(t \right)} \sec{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(- 9 \sin{\left(t \right)} \sec{\left(t \right)}\right) \\ & =2 \sin{\left(2 t \right)}\end{aligned}
